comment: SHA-256 manifest for vendored prebuilt third-party binaries and helper scripts under src/tasks/**/ps_modules. Every file listed here is pinned by content hash and must match before the extension can be packaged. If an entry is updated, record the upstream source (version + git commit) in the comment next to it and update this manifest in the same change. See build-scripts/verifyPsModules.ts for the verifier that enforces this manifest.

upstream.name: vsts-task-lib (VstsTaskSdk PowerShell SDK)
upstream.notes: Prebuilt PowerShell SDK vendored into this repository. The committed VstsTaskSdk.psd1 still contains the upstream _COMMIT_HASH_ / ModuleVersion = '0.1' build placeholders. Until the vendored copy is replaced with a pinned upstream release, the SHA-256 hashes below are what the build is pinned to.

authenticodeSignatures.comment: Authenticode publisher gate for the vendored .NET assemblies. verifyPsModules.ts invokes Get-AuthenticodeSignature on Windows and refuses to package if the subject does not match the expected publisher. The check is skipped (with a warning) on non-Windows platforms since Authenticode is only verifiable via the Windows CryptoAPI.
